title: Electronegativity across period 3
caption: Electronegativity rises across a period as nuclear charge increases and atomic radius falls, so a bonding pair is held more tightly: from sodium (0.93) to chlorine (3.16) on the Pauling scale.
alt: Bar chart of Pauling electronegativity rising across period 3 from Na 0.93 to Cl 3.16.
